profile_text.body:
Berkshire Grey, founded in 2013 and based in Bedford, Massachusetts, provides AI-powered robotic automation solutions for warehouse, ecommerce, retail, and 3PL logistics operations. The company describes its offering as physical AI warehouse automation that accelerates fulfillment, reduces operating costs, and scales with business needs.

The company's product line includes Stride, a shuttle sorting system that uses autonomous shuttles and intelligent routing to automate sorting across a wide range of item types, delivering what the company characterizes as reliable and scalable throughput.
